# Security Headers

## Single Source of Truth

All security headers are defined **only in `vite.config.ts`**. Do not:

- Edit `dist/_headers` directly (auto-generated by `productionCSP()` on every `vp build`)
- Add `<meta http-equiv>` tags manually in `index.html`
- Put headers in host platform config files (e.g. Netlify `netlify.toml`, Codeberg `.woodpecker.yaml`)

## CSP Objects

| Object                  | Where applied                                         |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `DEV_CSP`               | `vp dev` only — includes `unsafe-inline` for Vite HMR |
| `PROD_CSP`              | Production `<meta>` tag + `_headers` CSP              |
| `PROD_SECURITY_HEADERS` | All production response headers                       |
| `DEV_SECURITY_HEADERS`  | Dev server headers (CSP only)                         |

## HTTP-Header-Only Directives

These **cannot** be set via `<meta http-equiv>` — they are silently ignored:

- `frame-ancestors`, `Permissions-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`
- `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`

They belong only in `PROD_SECURITY_HEADERS`. `serializeMetaCSP()` automatically
excludes them when building the `<meta>` CSP tag.

## Adding a Header

```ts
// Add to PROD_SECURITY_HEADERS:
const PROD_SECURITY_HEADERS: Record<string, string> = {
  // existing headers ...
  "My-New-Header": "value",
};
```

Then run `vp build` — `dist/_headers` is regenerated automatically.

## SRI

SRI hashes are injected only for `.js` chunks. CSS SRI is intentionally omitted
because LightningCSS post-processing modifies CSS after `generateBundle`, making
any pre-computed hash stale and causing the browser to silently block the stylesheet.

## HSTS

Current value: `max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains` (2 years).

To enroll in the HSTS Preload List (irreversible — forces HTTPS for all subdomains
across all browsers): add `; preload` to the HSTS value, verify at
`https://hstspreload.org`, then submit. Only do this when you are certain every
subdomain of `larmart.de` will always serve HTTPS.

## `_headers` File Format

The `dist/_headers` file uses Netlify format, which git-pages also understands:

```
/*
  Header-Name: value
  Another-Header: value
```

- Path pattern on its own line, headers **indented** below it (two spaces)
- `/*` matches all paths
- `dist/_headers` is auto-generated by `productionCSP()` on every `vp build` — never edit it directly
